meta.title: Integration of immigrants
meta.question: Should immigrants keep their own ways, or adapt to Polish ones?
meta.measure: Average position on the integration of immigrants, from 0 (multiculturalism) to 10 (assimilation)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on whether immigrants enrich or undermine Polish culture and should adopt its customs, language and way of life, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Should foreigners settling permanently in Poland keep their culture, language and customs as distinct as possible (1) ... abandon them and adopt Polish culture entirely (4)?
For the greater good of society, is it better if immigrants maintain their distinct customs and traditions (0) or take over the customs of the country (10)?
Cultural life undermined or enriched by immigrants
It is better for a country if almost everyone shares the same customs and traditions (agree-disagree)
How important should it be for immigrants to be committed to the country's way of life?
How important should it be for immigrants to speak the country's official language?
To be fully accepted members of society, people belonging to minority groups must give up their own culture
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2003 (ZA3983, 1 survey); the EB 'majorities and minorities' battery.

items.wording: Immigrants should be required to adapt to the customs of the country
Better if immigrants maintain their distinct customs and traditions (1) ... take over the customs of the country / do not maintain them (10)
items.notes: European Values Study 2008, 2017 (2 surveys). The 10 end is worded 'take over the customs of the country' in 2008 and 'do not maintain distinct customs' in 2017.

items.wording: The presence of immigrants harms Polish culture (agree-disagree)
Minorities should adapt to the customs and traditions of Poland (agree-disagree)
Cultural life undermined or enriched by immigrants
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Integration programmes should respect cultural difference and not force assimilation (1) ... immigrants should adopt Polish values and way of life (7)
items.notes: FNW SWPS online surveys May and December 2025 (2 surveys).
